title: Replace image at selected element with new volleyball action photo

requirements.text: Save the uploaded volleyball action photo (player #7 'Sarah' setting the ball at a championship match) as 'frontend/public/assets/generated/volleyball-action-setter.dim_1024x1024.jpg'. Then, in the component that renders the element at XPath /html[1]/body[1]/div[1]/div[1]/main[1]/div[1]/section[3]/div[1]/div[2]/a[2]/div[1]/div[1], replace the existing image with the new asset 'volleyball-action-setter.dim_1024x1024.jpg'. Remove any reference to the old image that was previously in that slot.

quotes: delete old image and add this new image

acceptanceCriteria: The new volleyball action photo is saved at 'frontend/public/assets/generated/volleyball-action-setter.dim_1024x1024.jpg'.
The element at XPath /html[1]/body[1]/div[1]/div[1]/main[1]/div[1]/section[3]/div[1]/div[2]/a[2]/div[1]/div[1] displays the new image.
No reference to the old image remains in that component or element.

constraints: Only modify the element at the specified XPath. Do not alter other images or sections on the page.
nonGoals: Changing any other page content, layout, or styling beyond the targeted image replacement.
Modifying the navigation bar logo or any other image on the site.

required: Volleyball championship match action photo: female player in blue 'Stars 7 Sarah' jersey jumping to set a Molten volleyball at the net, crowded gymnasium with 'Championship Volleyball' banners in background (volleyball-action-setter.dim_1024x1024.jpg)
